stdout:
usage: cli.py [-h] [--version] {run,caption,plan,ground} ...

Culture transcreation research CLI.

positional arguments:
  {run,caption,plan,ground}
    run                 Run automated planning/reviewed grounding/replay or
                        explicit guided research from JSON
    caption             Caption one image with SmolVLM-500M
    plan                Plan cultural edits with local Ollama; never modifies
                        images
    ground              Research-only text localization; never executes
                        planner edits

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

usage: cli.py run [-h] --input INPUT

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT  PipelineInput or independent ResearchInput JSON; paths
                 relative to current directory

usage: run_pipeline.py [-h] --input INPUT

Run planning, reviewed grounding tests, or read-only research replay; never
generate.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT

usage: segment_sam.py [-h] --image IMAGE [--image-sha256 IMAGE_SHA256]
                      --detection DETECTION
                      [--prediction-index PREDICTION_INDEX] [--points POINTS]
                      (--research-only | --review REVIEW) --note NOTE
                      [--config CONFIG] [--device {cuda,cpu}] --out OUT

Independent SAM research CLI; run as a module from the repository root.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --image IMAGE
  --image-sha256 IMAGE_SHA256
  --detection DETECTION
  --prediction-index PREDICTION_INDEX
  --points POINTS       Optional source-bound research point JSON; coordinates
                        stay in original pixels
  --research-only
  --review REVIEW
  --note NOTE           Why this exact source box is being tested
  --config CONFIG
  --device {cuda,cpu}
  --out OUT             New artifact directory only

usage: inpaint.py [-h] --input INPUT [--config CONFIG] --out OUT

Run one explicitly scoped inpainting research request, independently of the
planner.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT    Explicit RESEARCH_ONLY request with pinned source hashes
  --config CONFIG
  --out OUT        New experiment directory

usage: review_mask.py [-h] {prepare,decide} ...

Review saved SAM masks for controlled segmentation tests, never for editing.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,decide}
    prepare         Copy existing evidence and create only PENDING human
                    requests
    decide          Record a real human decision; not automated approval

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
